title: {p} & {v} Coconut Curry
steps: Cook the {spice} in a little oil for a minute, until fragrant.
Add the {p} and {v} and stir for 2 minutes, then pour in the {sauce} and simmer 10 to 15 minutes, until {doneness}.
Season with soy or fish sauce and lime to taste, and serve over the {s}.
tip: Use more veg than meat, light coconut milk if you have it, and a smaller portion of rice.
